name: Avalonia MVVM Application
description: A cross-platform Avalonia desktop application with Views, ViewModels and Models using CommunityToolkit.Mvvm; requires the .NET 10 SDK or newer.
projectFileContent:
<Project>
  <PropertyGroup>
    <BaseOutputPath>../bin/$(MSBuildProjectName)/</BaseOutputPath>
    <BaseIntermediateOutputPath>../obj/$(MSBuildProjectName)/</BaseIntermediateOutputPath>
  </PropertyGroup>
  <Import Project="Sdk.props" Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk" />
  <PropertyGroup>
    <ManagePackageVersionsCentrally>false</ManagePackageVersionsCentrally>
    <OutputType>WinExe</OutputType>
    <TargetFramework>{{TargetFramework}}</TargetFramework>
    <LangVersion>14.0</LangVersion>
    <Nullable>enable</Nullable>
    <ImplicitUsings>enable</ImplicitUsings>
    <AvaloniaUseCompiledBindingsByDefault>true</AvaloniaUseCompiledBindingsByDefault>
  </PropertyGroup>
  <ItemGroup>
    <PackageReference Include="Avalonia" Version="12.1.4" />
    <PackageReference Include="Avalonia.Desktop" Version="12.1.4" />
    <PackageReference Include="Avalonia.Themes.Fluent" Version="12.1.4" />
    <PackageReference Include="Avalonia.Fonts.Inter" Version="12.1.4" />
    <PackageReference Include="CommunityToolkit.Mvvm" Version="8.4.2" />
  </ItemGroup>
  <Import Project="Sdk.targets" Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk" />
</Project>

files.content:
<Window xmlns="https://github.com/avaloniaui"
        xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
        xmlns:vm="using:{{ProjectNameIdentifier}}.ViewModels"
        x:Class="{{ProjectNameIdentifier}}.Views.MainWindow"
        x:DataType="vm:MainWindowViewModel"
        Title="{{ProjectName}}"
        Width="480"
        Height="280">
  <StackPanel Margin="24" Spacing="12" VerticalAlignment="Center">
    <TextBlock Text="Name" />
    <TextBox Text="{Binding Name, Mode=TwoWay}" PlaceholderText="Enter your name" />
    <Button Content="Greet" Command="{Binding GreetCommand}" HorizontalAlignment="Left" />
    <TextBlock Text="{Binding Greeting}" />
  </StackPanel>
</Window>
